questions.question: In which one of the following places was Asia’s first Export Processing Zone (EPZ) set up?
questions.solution:
• India was the first country to set up Asia’s first Export Processing Zone (EPZ) in Kandla in 1965.
 
• Shannon in Ireland was the place where the first Export Processing Zone (EPZ) was set up in 1959.
 
• EPZs are the areas within the developing nations that offer a barrier-free environment and incentives to promote economic growth by attracting foreign investment for export-oriented production.

questions.question: In which year, the Railway Budget and the General Budget were presented separately?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The Railway Budget and the General Budget were presented separately for the first time in the year **1924**__.
 
• The Acworth Committee, chaired by Sir William Acworth, pointed out that the entire railway system needed a unified management, hence on the recommendation of the Committee, the government started presenting the Railway budget separately from the General budget henceforth every year.

questions.question: The ruler of which dynasty of South India assumed the title of ‘Dharmaraj’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Western Ganga**__.

__
 
• The title** "Dharmaraj"** was given to the ruler of **South India's Western Ganga dynasty. **
 
• From roughly** 350 to 1000 CE,** the Western Ganga dynasty ruled over **ancient Karnataka in India.**
 
• To distinguish them from the **Eastern Gangas,** they are referred to as "**Western Gangas**."

 From roughly** 350 to 550 CE**, the Western Ganga ruled from **Kolar.**
 
• Later, they moved their capital to** Talakadu on the banks of the Kaveri River **in what is now the Mysore region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wakatak:**

 
 
• In the middle of the **third century CE, the Deccan** was the place of the genesis of the ancient Indian dynasty known as the **Vakataka.**
 
 
 
• **Pallava:**
 
 
• From **275 CE to 897 CE,** the Pallava dynasty ruled over a sizable area of the **Deccan**, also known as **Tondaimandalam.**
 
 
 
• **Kadamba:**
 
 
• An** ancient Karnataka royal dynasty** was the **Kadambas**. The kingdom was founded by **Mayurasharma in c. 345.**

questions.question: Which geographical division of India is the oldest?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Peninsular.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **oldest geographical division of India** is the **Peninsular plateau.**
 
• It covers a total area of around **16 lakh square km** and is roughly **triangular in shape.**
 
• **The Himalayas** form the Northern mountainous region of India, being the highest mountain range in the world.
 
• Present in front of the Himalayas, the** Ganga-Brahmaputra Plain** represents a sediment-filled foreland basin.
 
• The** Coastal plain of India** stretches from Gujarat to West Bengal, which is divided into western and eastern Coastal plains.

questions.question: Who is considered to be the promoter of ‘Bhakti Movement’ in Bengal?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chaitanya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhakti movement 

 
 
• The Bhakti Movement originated in the **seventh century** in Tamil, South India (now parts of Tamil Nadu and Kerala), and spread northwards.
 
• The first Bhakti Movement was organized by Ramanujacharya.​
 
 
• ​He was an exponent of the Vishitadvaita philosophy.
 
 
 
 
 
• **​Chaitanya**
 
 
• The famous Saint** Chaitanya of Benga**l was a contemporary of** Alauddin Husain Shah**.
 
• Chaitanya Mahaprabhu (**1486 - 1534**) was a Vedic spiritual leader.
 
• He founded **Gaudiya Vaishnavism**.
 
• Chaitanya was the advocator for the Vaishnava school of **Bhakti yoga**.
 
• He is revered as** Krishna**.
 
• He popularized the chanting of the **Hare Krishna mantra**.
 
• He composed the Siksastakam (**eight devotional prayers**) in Sanskrit.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ramananda**

 
 
• Saint Ramananda is associated with **Ram Magri**.
 
• Ramananda (**14th century**) was the chief pioneer of Ram Bhakti.
 
• For the most part of his life, he lived in **Varanasi**.
 
• Born in a Brahmin family, he was a devotional poet.
 
• His disciples include **Saint Kabir**, **Guru Ravidas,** and **others**.
 
 
 
• **Namdev**
 
 
• He also known as Nam Dayv, Namdeo, or Namadeva, was an Indian poet and saint from Narsi, Hingoli, Maharashtra, India within the Varkari tradition of Hinduism.
 
• He lived as a devotee of Lord Vitthala (Krishna) of Pandharpur.
 
 

 
• Ramanuja__:

 
 
• Ramanuja, an 11th-century Vaishnava saint, was the most influential thinker of Vaishnavism.
 
• His philosophy, known as vishistadvaita, proclaims that the soul retains its identity even after uniting with Brahma.
 
• 
 
He established centers to spread his doctrine of devotion, Srivaishnavism, to God Vishnu and his consort Lakshmi.

questions.question: Which of the following has become the first country in the world to pay equal salary to men and women?
questions.solution:
The current answer is __**Iceland**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Iceland, in January 2018 became the first country in the world to pay equal salaries to men and women by passing a law for the same in the Parliament in June.**

questions.question:
Metals are generally ______.

I. Ductile

II. Malleable

III. Poor conductors of heat
questions.solution:
A metal refers to an alloy, compound, or element which is a __**ductile, malleable **__and **good conductor of both heat and electricity.** The other properties of metals include:

__
 
• They have high boiling and melting points.
 
• They are hard and cannot be broken easily.
 
• They are physically lustrous.
 
• They react with non-metals to form ionic bonds.

Concept:__

Metals

__
 
• Metals are shiny in appearance.
 
• Solid metals are good conductors of electricity.
 
• Metals are strong and hard.
 
• Metals are malleable and ductile.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**Malleability

 
• The property of a substance that describes its ability to bent or is hammered into a thin sheet without breaking.
 
• Gold is the most malleable and ductile of all metals.
 
• Gold can be rolled and beaten to a thickness less than the wavelength of visible light, but so far there has been no scientific explanation of this unique property.

The most malleable metal is Silver.

 
• Gold, Silver, Aluminium are highly malleable metals. Out of the given options, Silver (Ag) is the most malleable.
 
• Generally, metals are hard. Exception: Sodium (Na) and potassium (K) are soft and can be easily cut by a knife.

questions.question: According to Dalton’s Atomic Theory, the smallest indivisible particles of matter are called ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is an __**atom.**__

__**Explanation;**__

Dalton's atomic theory

 
• All matter is made up of tiny, indivisible particles called atoms.
 
• All atoms of a specific element are identical in mass, size, and other properties. However, atoms of different elements exhibit different properties and vary in mass and size.
 
• Atoms can neither be created nor destroyed. Furthermore, atoms cannot be divided into smaller particles.
 
• Atoms of different elements can combine in fixed whole-number ratios to form compounds.
 
• Atoms can be rearranged, combined, or separated in chemical reactions.
 
• Dalton based his theory on the law of conservation of mass and the law of constant composition.
 
• Though Dalton was the first to discover the atomic theory of matter there were certain limitations or drawbacks of his atomic theory which are as follows:-
 
• Limitations of Dalton's Atomic Theory:
 
 
• Atoms consist of particles like electrons, protons, and neutrons but Dalton said atoms are indivisible and can neither be created nor be destroyed.
 
• The Discovery of isotopes revealed that the atoms of the same element possess different weights

questions.question: Who appoints the Chief Election Commissioner of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The President of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chief Election Commissioner** of India:-

 
 
• It is appointed by the **President **__of India.
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner of India is usually a member of either the Indian Administrative Service or the Indian Civil Service.
 
• The current Chief Election Commissioner of India is Rajiv Kumar.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Chief Justice of India:-​

 
 
• CJI is the highest-ranking officer of the Indian federal judiciary.
 
• The Chief Justice of India and the Judges of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President under clause (2) of Article 124 of the Constitution.
 
• Appointment to the office of the Chief Justice of India should be of the seniormost Judge of the Supreme Court considered fit to hold the office.
 
• The Union Minister of Law at the appropriate time, seeks the recommendation of the outgoing Chief Justice of India for the appointment of the next Chief Justice of India.
 
 
 
• Prime Minister of India:-
 
 
• The prime minister is appointed by the president of India; however, the prime minister has to enjoy the confidence of the majority of Lok Sabha members, who are directly elected every five years, lest the prime minister shall resign.
 
• A member of either the Lok Sabha or the Rajya Sabha can be appointed as the Prime Minister.
 
• Other Ministers shall be appointed by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister.
 
 
 
• **Home Minister of India:-**
 
 
• The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) is responsible for carrying out a wide range of duties.
 
• The most significant of these are internal security, border management, center-state relations, administration of union territories, command of the Central Armed Police Forces, and disaster management.
 
• Amit Shah is the current Home Minister of India.

questions.question:
Who among the following holds the office during the pleasure of President?

I. Attorney General of India

II. Governors of states

III. Comptroller and Auditor General of India
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Attorney General of India:-**

 
 
• It is a part of the Union Executive.
 
• He is the highest law officer in the country.
 
• Article 76 provides for the Attorney General of India, hence it is a constitutional office.
 
• His term is not fixed by the constitution and he works at the pleasure of the President.
 
• Functions-
 
 
• To advise, the government upon such legal matters, referred by President.
 
• To appear on behalf of the GoI in all cases in the Supreme Court or in High Court.
 
• To represent the GoI in any reference made by the President to the Supreme Court under Article 143.
 
• To discharge the functions conferred by on him by the constitution or any other law.
 
 
 
 
 
• Governor of any State :
 
 
• He is appointed by President by warrant under his hand and seal.
 
• **They remain in office as per the wishes of the President.**
 
• Executive powers of State are embedded within him.
 
• Generally, they remain in office for five years.
 
 
 
• ** Comptroller and Auditor General of India:-**
 
 
• CAG is an independent authority under the Constitution of India.
 
• He is the head of the Indian audit & account department and chief Guardian of the Public purse.
 
• It is the institution through which the accountability of the government and other public authorities (all those who spend public funds) to Parliament and State Legislatures and through them to the people is ensured.
 
• The present Comptroller and Auditor General of India as on November 2022 is Girish Chandra Murmu (from 2020).
 
• CAG does not hold office during the pleasure of the President.

questions.question: Which of the following protects the inner lining of the stomach from the action of hydrochloric acid under normal conditions?
questions.solution:

questions.question: Calculate the pressure (in Pa) if a thrust of 800 N is applied to an area of 16 m2.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**50**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Pressure = Force/Area

therefore, Pressure = 800/16= 50 Pa (Pascal- unit of pressure).

questions.question: Warm air is ______.

options.text: heavier than cold air hence warm air rises up
lighter than cold air hence warm air moves down
lighter than cold air hence warm air rises up
heavier than cold air hence warm air moves down

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**lighter than cold air hence warm air rises up**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Warm air is lighter (less dense) than cold air, hence it rises up.
 
• When the air is heated it expands and becomes less dense than the air around it. It then tends to rise up.

questions.question: In Microsoft Word, first line and hanging are special forms of __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indentation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In Microsoft Word, the first line and hanging are special forms of** indentation.**
 
• **Alignment** lets you position your text as you want.
 
• **Line spacing or spacing** allows you to customize the space between a line in a paragraph.
 
• **Effects** let you change the look of your text by changing the outline, changing colour, or adding any effects to make it look good, different, or better.
